premises.text: Hiring fails because candidates and employers decide on the wrong data: hidden jobs and soft-skill mismatch while resumes show only hard skills
premises.evidence_span: everyone, both candidates and employers, are making decisions based on the wrong data

premises.text: Cognitive assessments best predict job performance but are long, expensive, and slow, so they go unused
premises.evidence_span: cognitive assessments, are the single most accurate predictors of job performance across the board

premises.text: Science-based mobile games measure and quantify soft skills into a cognitive fingerprint in about 20 minutes
premises.evidence_span: In just 20 minutes, our science-based mobile games measure and quantify soft skills

premises.text: Predictive models built from a company's top performers match candidates likely to perform similarly, filtering irrelevant demographic signals
premises.evidence_span: we take the predictive model based off of Aiden and cross-reference it against everyone on our platform who's played the game

premises.text: Companies pay a setup fee plus subscription or sourcing fees; games are free for candidates to play
premises.evidence_span: Companies like Cloud Co pay us a one-time setup fee for creating the predictive model based on their top performers, and then a subscription

domains.name: wrong-data hiring and unused cognitive tests

value.text: Help companies build world-class teams by matching on predictors of job success

secondary_value.text: Candidates learn about their own unique talents by playing for free
secondary_value.evidence_span: free for anyone to download and play to learn more about themselves and their own unique talents
